8002.title: Pending mention searches outlive their response timeout
8002.rootCauseOneLine: The response timeout does not retain registration-level pending-search state, so later requests start overlapping plugin work.

prReviews.topFinding: Registration guard targets the verified gap; closed contribution not executed.

8002.proposedFix: Guard pending search registrations until the underlying promise settles, independent of the response deadline.
8002.caveats: Accumulation reproduced twice on trusted source; macOS authorization and filesystem-worker exhaustion were not recreated.
